speaker: SPEAKER_00
transcript: They do, they feel helpless, but I want to tell you something, a phone call to your Congress, representative, or your senator. I don't care if it's state or federal, that's a big help. The other thing I tell people to do, and actually I felt bad because I was not running for Congress, but I was in a different state talking to some people, and they asked me that same question, and I said, get involved. I don't care if it's your homeowners association, it won't let you fly your flag. Your city council, your mayor's position, your county government, your state government, your federal government, start running and get involved and be part of the decision making. I don't care if it's poll watching, poll working, whatever, just get involved. And that would be a huge help. Once you get the average person involved in all forms and all branches of the political arena, You'll see some good changes being made. Congressman Mike Collins, thank you, my friend. Appreciate it. Appreciate your time. Thanks for having me on.
